problems.title_zh: 用统计物理学方法处理约束满足问题面临的五个挑战
problems.title_en: Five Challenges on the Statistical Mechanics Approach to Constraint Satisfaction Problems
problems.question: Challenge 5 (k>=4 instance): certified rational a_k < best published upper bound with P[F_k(n,floor(a_k n)) SAT] -> 0, k=4,5 (6,7).

key_sources.match: Achlioptas-Peres JAMS 2004 table p.2: upper bounds 10.23 (k=4), 21.33 (k=5), 87.88 (k=7); lower 7.91/18.79/84.82
MMZ 2006 Table 1 cavity values 9.931/21.117/43.37/87.79 (opened by scout)
Ding-Sly-Sun: exact threshold only for k>=k0, k0 unspecified (opened by scout)
Vorobyev 2026: k=3 only, 4.268, Lean-formalized; method template; no k>=4 remark
Achlioptas-Menchaca-Mendez ICALP 2012 energetic interpolation, single-probability trial, no k-SAT numbers

problems.plausibility: speculative [INFERENCE]; the general-k analytic bridge is unproved here
problems.notes: Probes (floating point, NOT certificates; probes/OUTPUT.txt): single-rate boundary ~10.01 for k=4 (record 10.23); Phi(21.2)<0 for k=5 (record 21.33); Phi(43.45)<0 for k=6 (first-moment 44.01); Phi(87.85)<0 for k=7 (record 87.88). Positive control: the k-general functional reproduces Vorobyev's k=3 three-rate certificate exactly (variable -0.76119275, clause +0.76118155, Psi_128=-1.1203e-5 at 1067/250; +0.0233 at a=4.0). Main risks: general-k interpolation proof P1; unfound prior art (re-check arXiv before launch); the alternating binomial series needs high-precision inputs (double-precision nu_i gave garbage ~1e43 in a probe). Fits 4 threads/4 GB/1 GB. Multi-rate probe (3 rates, Decimal, T=128, not certificate): k=4 Psi(9.94)~-3.7e-4; k=5 Psi(21.125)~-3.5e-5; k=3 Psi(4.268)~-1.0e-5. Realistic targets r4<=9.94, r5<=21.13. Parent review supersedes screening confidence and six-hour attack schedule: four-hour attack, two-hour P1 go/no-go, conditional inequality by default; recover baseline sources/models and certify comfortable margins first.

requirements: Use three claim levels: floating-point negativity is evidence only; exact or interval negativity with rigorously signed truncation is a certified inequality only; a threshold theorem requires every analytic bridge to be written and accepted.

Threshold target: for each k in {4,5}, exhibit rational a_k below 10.23 and 21.33 respectively and prove P[F_k(n, floor(a_k n)) is satisfiable]->0 with independent clauses, uniformly chosen distinct variables within each clause, and independent fair signs.

Prove the general-k interpolation inequality for each selected k, explicitly checking odd k=5 hypotheses; finite-y or y-limit control; expectation-to-high-probability concentration; and Poisson/fixed-count plus repeated/distinct-variable transfers with explicit losses. Numerical replay cannot discharge these obligations. Vorobyev k=3 work is only a method lead.
Before using improves, recover the original source and random model behind the 10.23 and 21.33 baselines. Check Achlioptas-Menchaca-Mendez 2012 and its citing works for existing k>=4 numbers.
Tripwire: a value at or below cavity estimates 9.931 (k=4) or 21.117 (k=5) is a probable bug. Certify comfortable margins first (around k=4 at 9.96; k=5 at or above 21.14), not k=5 at 21.125.
Decide by about two attack hours whether the interpolation inequality holds; build certificate tools in parallel. Success confidence is speculative; 9.94 and 21.125 are search targets only.

Without all analytic bridges, report only a certified negative trial-functional value conditional on the stated inequality. Even with them, this is partial progress on Challenge 5: no lower bounds, no exact thresholds, and no solution of the broader program.
